Download controlnet: https://huggingface.co/InstantX/FLUX.1-dev-Controlnet-Union/tree/main

从 ComfyUI 管理器安装 ComfyUI-eesahesNodes（包含 InstantXFluxUnionControlNetLoader）
Install ComfyUI-eesahesNodes from the ComfyUI Manager (with InstantXFluxUnionControlNetLoader)

添加画面描述和画面细节描述,越丰富越好并选择合适的分辨率比例，最终图片分辨率会乘1.5倍。

Add a description of the picture and the details of the picture description, the richer the better and choose the appropriate resolution ratio, the final image resolution will be multiplied by 1.5 .

Optionally, you can close step 2 and then turn it on when step 1 is satisfied.
